title: More Crafts by Juix
description: Datapack adding some useful Recipes that feel Vanilla
body:
# ℹ️ More Crafts By Juix The More Crafts pack will add new recipes to your game, for various items that cannot currently be crafted, such as a trident, a horse armor, or even an enchanted golden apple.
This pack is compatible with mods like JEI or REI.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7fad1207852fab653f31b3177a5d83612a3c56a_0.webp)
# ⚒️ Recipes Please go to the Gallery page to explore all of them
# 🪳 Known issues - No known issue for now Quick report - https://juixcode.github.io/contact
# 🔃 Ask for a version You can **report a bug** or ask me to **update one of my pack to a specific version**, using one of these contact methods : - Quick message - https://juixcode.github.io/contact - My mail - juixcontact@gmail.com - The Discord server - clikc-here-to-join
# ❤️ Donations If you like my packs, you can tip me on my Ko-Fi page. Thank you so much if you do !
